SELECT FROM dms_shop_order WHERE id = #{id} AND COALESCE(tenant_id, 1) = #{tenantId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM dms_shop_order WHERE order_no = #{orderNo} AND COALESCE(tenant_id, 1) = #{tenantId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM dms_shop_order WHERE trade_id=#{tradeId} AND COALESCE(tenant_id, 1) = #{tenantId} ORDER BY id ASC FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM dms_shop_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND COALESCE(tenant_id, 1) = #{tenantId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT FROM dms_shop_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND COALESCE(tenant_id, 1) = #{tenantId}
AND status = 0
AND status = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_after_sale sale WHERE sale.order_id = dms_shop_order.id AND sale.status NOT IN (1, 2, 3) )
AND status = 2 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_after_sale sale WHERE sale.order_id = dms_shop_order.id AND sale.status NOT IN (1, 2, 3) )
AND status = 3 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_order_item oi WHERE oi.order_id = dms_shop_order.id AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_product_review review WHERE review.order_item_id = oi.id ) )
AND ( status = 5 OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_after_sale sale WHERE sale.order_id = dms_shop_order.id ) )
ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_payment, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_after_sale sale WHERE sale.order_id = o.id AND sale.status NOT IN (1, 2, 3) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_shipment, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 2 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_after_sale sale WHERE sale.order_id = o.id AND sale.status NOT IN (1, 2, 3) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_receipt, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 3 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_order_item oi WHERE oi.order_id = o.id AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_product_review review WHERE review.order_item_id = oi.id ) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_review, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_after_sale sale WHERE sale.order_id = o.id AND sale.status NOT IN (1, 2, 3) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS after_sale FROM dms_shop_order o WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND COALESCE(o.tenant_id, 1) = #{tenantId}

SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, 0 AS pending_payment, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_after_sale sale WHERE sale.order_id = o.id AND sale.status NOT IN (1, 2, 3) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_shipment, 0 AS pending_receipt, 0 AS pending_review, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_after_sale sale WHERE sale.order_id = o.id AND sale.status NOT IN (1, 2, 3) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS after_sale FROM dms_shop_order o WHERE COALESCE(o.tenant_id, 1) = #{tenantId} AND o.merchant_id=#{merchantId}
SELECT FROM dms_shop_order WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND COALESCE(tenant_id, 1) = #{tenantId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM dms_shop_order WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND COALESCE(tenant_id, 1) = #{tenantId} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT FROM dms_shop_order profile_order WHERE profile_order.user_id = #{userId} AND COALESCE(profile_order.tenant_id, 1) = #{tenantId} AND profile_order.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND ( profile_order.status IN (1, 2, 3) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_after_sale profile_sale WHERE profile_sale.order_id = profile_order.id ) ) ORDER BY profile_order.create_time DESC

SELECT FROM dms_shop_order
AND COALESCE(tenant_id, 1) = #{tenantId}
AND merchant_id = #{merchantId}
AND status = #{status}
AND status = 0
AND status = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_after_sale sale WHERE sale.order_id = dms_shop_order.id AND sale.status NOT IN (1, 2, 3) )
AND status = 2 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_after_sale sale WHERE sale.order_id = dms_shop_order.id AND sale.status NOT IN (1, 2, 3) )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_after_sale sale WHERE sale.order_id = dms_shop_order.id AND sale.status NOT IN (1, 2, 3) )
AND status = 3 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_after_sale sale WHERE sale.order_id = dms_shop_order.id AND sale.status NOT IN (1, 2, 3) )
AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_after_sale sale WHERE sale.order_id = dms_shop_order.id AND sale.apply_type IN (1, 2) AND sale.status = 1 ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_after_sale sale WHERE sale.order_id = dms_shop_order.id AND sale.status NOT IN (1, 2, 3) )
AND ( order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR trade_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR payment_order_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR receiver_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR receiver_phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR service_remark LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dms_shop_order (id, order_no, trade_id, trade_no, payment_order_no, tenant_id, merchant_id, merchant_name, user_id, agent_id, invite_code, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, receiver_province, receiver_city, receiver_district, receiver_detail_address, total_amount, freight_amount, discount_amount, pay_amount, total_pv, total_cost, business_type, business_source_id, source_live_room_id, status, pay_type, remark, pay_time, delivery_company, delivery_no, delivery_time, receive_time, cancel_time, close_time) VALUES (#{order.id}, #{order.orderNo}, #{order.tradeId}, #{order.tradeNo}, #{order.paymentOrderNo}, #{tenantId}, #{order.merchantId}, #{order.merchantName}, #{order.userId}, #{order.agentId}, #{order.inviteCode}, #{order.receiverName}, #{order.receiverPhone}, #{order.receiverAddress}, #{order.receiverProvince}, #{order.receiverCity}, #{order.receiverDistrict}, #{order.receiverDetailAddress}, #{order.totalAmount}, #{order.freightAmount}, #{order.discountAmount}, #{order.payAmount}, #{order.totalPv}, #{order.totalCost}, #{order.businessType}, #{order.businessSourceId}, #{order.sourceLiveRoomId}, #{order.status}, #{order.payType}, #{order.remark}, #{order.payTime}, #{order.deliveryCompany}, #{order.deliveryNo}, #{order.deliveryTime}, #{order.receiveTime}, #{order.cancelTime}, #{order.closeTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE dms_shop_order SET agent_id=#{agentId}, update_time=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND COALESCE(tenant_id, 1) = #{tenantId}

UPDATE dms_shop_order SET status = 2, delivery_company = #{deliveryCompany}, delivery_no = #{deliveryNo}, delivery_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 1 AND COALESCE(tenant_id, 1) = #{tenantId}

UPDATE dms_shop_order SET status = 3, receive_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 2 AND COALESCE(tenant_id, 1) = #{tenantId} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM dms_shop_after_sale sale WHERE sale.order_id = dms_shop_order.id AND sale.status NOT IN (1, 2, 3) )
UPDATE dms_shop_order SET status = 4, cancel_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 0 AND COALESCE(tenant_id, 1) = #{tenantId}
UPDATE dms_shop_order SET status = 4, close_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN (1, 2, 3) AND COALESCE(tenant_id, 1) = #{tenantId}
